summary: Comprehensive first-run testing for Casadella Photo Studio. Backend pytest suite covers auth, role enforcement (staff 403 on booking/tx/package, admin 403 on users/settings), 44 slots with 09:00-19:45 range and 60-min package unavailable at 19:15, booking create/overlap(409)/cancel, DP+pelunasan with status progression and auto POS income txn + overpay 400, POS expenses (operasional/sewa) and daily report net=revenue-expenses, attendance duplicate prevention, user CRUD by super admin. All 19 backend tests PASS. Frontend mobile UI (390x844) verified: PIN login screen loads, wrong PIN shows 'PIN Salah' with shake, tabs Beranda/Jadwal/Kasir/Lainnya present, Admin1 sees Booking Baru / 'Paket Foto' + 'Absensi Staf' (no SUPER ADMIN section), Super Admin sees additional 'Staf & Hak Akses' + 'Pengaturan Sistem', Staff (Rina) has no FAB on Jadwal nor Super Admin section on Lainnya. Booking form screen opens with all expected testIDs (client-name, phone, package chips, day-strip, photographer/editor chips including 'none', notes, save). No deprecated expo packages (no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.76+ web compatibility.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` to silence RN web console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 478-line file; acceptable for scope but consider splitting routers (auth/users/bookings/pos/attendance) as feature set grows.
attendance.local_date() hardcodes UTC+7 offset for WIB; works for Indonesia but not timezone-configurable.
report() aggregates in-memory; fine for scale, but a Mongo aggregation pipeline would scale better long-term.
No pagination on /transactions (limited to 2000) or /bookings (1000) list queries; acceptable for internal studio tool.
No index hints created on bookings.date / transactions.date; add Mongo indexes if dataset grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows verified; booking save→payment sheet end-to-end not exercised via UI (deferred due to time, but underlying API verified via pytest)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed created; test suite cleans up its own TEST_* transactions and TEST_Photo user. Booking created during tests is cancelled at end of class. Backend seeded users/packages from startup event remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: tap [data-testid=login-user-<id>] then 6 presses of [data-testid=login-key-<digit>] auto-submits. Public URL: https://photo-studio-control.preview.emergentagent.com. Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Super Admin seed PIN comes from SEED_SUPERADMIN_PIN in backend/.env (currently 123456). Test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. POS screen uses testID report-period (Segmented), home has home-new-booking-button, booking form uses booking-save-button, package picks are booking-package-<id>, photographer picks booking-photographer-<id>|none.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All backend endpoints behave per spec; all role gates return 403 correctly; slot generation (44 slots 09:00-19:45 at 15-min step) and overlap/boundary logic are correct; payment status transitions belum_bayar→dp→lunas with overpay 400 and auto POS income are correct; report net_income math matches revenue - (operasional+sewa).
